About Me

I am an Associate Professor at the Department of Computing Science and Technology, University of Cambridge. Before joining Cambridge, I was an Assistant Professor at the School of Computing and Information Systems, Singapore Management University. Prior to that, I worked as a postdoctoral researcher at the Department of Computer Science and Technology, University of Cambridge, advised by Prof. Cecilia Mascolo. I earned my PhD at the School of Computer Science and Engineering, University of New South Wales, Australia in 2019, supervised by Prof. Mahbub Hassan and Prof. Wen Hu. I also worked as a Research Assistant at DATA61-CSIRO, Australia from 2016 to 2019. I had my bachelor and master study in Communication Engineering at Central South University, China, from 2010 to 2016.
